name: nagpur_localities
source: Traced from the index panel of 'Map showing boundary of Nagpur Municipal Corporation, Dist: Nagpur' (NMC intention map for the revised development plan, scale 1:25,000, scanned 2025-06-16)
method: Automatic segmentation of the scanned index map, names read from the map, similarity fit to the OSM NMC boundary; inside the old limit the outer edge follows the OSM boundary
notes: Revenue villages (mouzas). 'Nagpur and Sitabuldi' and 'Takali Sim and Jaitala' could not be separated. Mankapur, Wadpakhad, Bhankheda, Hansapuri, Hiwari, Harpur and Dabha were grown from seed points and are the least reliable shapes.
